title: Katrepeler Straße, Bremen
description:
Property:
The house is ideal for a family of four who would like to live in Bremen temporarily for at least six months. The house is fully furnished and fully equipped with everything you need for living. You can arrive with suitcases and should find everything you need. If you are still missing something and it is not something quite extraordinary, it will be added. 

Overall, it is a very bright, light-flooded house with a bedroom (one bedroom is equipped with an extra long bed, 2.2 meter inside), two living/bedrooms including Smart TV or TV, a living room with Smart TV and an open work area with desk (the half room), a kitchen-living room, an interior shower room in the basement and a bathroom with window and a combination bathtub/shower on the first floor, a combination room (heating and laundry room) and a storage room. WiFi is available in the house. The living room/bedroom in the basement and the bedroom have shutters on the windows. The living room/bedroom in the attic has pleated blinds. On the south-west side there is a small courtyard terrace with a large awning and a small balcony on the first floor.

The kitchen is equipped with an electric cooker/oven with extractor hood, a dishwasher, a fridge with freezer compartment and a microwave. There is a washing machine and tumble dryer in the laundry room. 

The laundry room is also the boiler room, where there is a new gas central heating system with a connected 120 liter hot water tank (December 2023) and a circulation pump.

In addition to the living space of 127 square meters, the storage room and the combined room (heating and laundry room) together measure a further 21 square meters.

Location:
The house is located in the original part of Findorff, one of the most popular districts in Bremen. Bremen's largest weekly market, the Bürgerpark, the main train station and many stores for daily needs as well as several restaurants and (kebab) snack bars are within walking distance. An elementary school and a secondary school are also within walking distance. The public transport connections are also very good. The bus stops for lines 25, 26 and 27 are approx. 200 meters away. Despite its proximity to the city center and train station, the house is very quietly located in a purely residential street in the third row parallel to a main road.

Miscellaneous:
The house was extensively renovated from mid-2023 to early 2025. The walls in the basement were treated against moisture and the sewer in the house was renovated. With the exception of the two staircases from the first floor to the first floor and from there to the attic as well as in the work area (where the paintwork is still very good), all walls were painted in all living rooms and in the basement. Some of the windows were replaced and the roof renovated. All lighting has been converted to LED (the only exception is the oven light, which is not LED). It will now be a first occupancy after this work.

The rent is understood to be a “cold rent” of 1,750 euros per month. In addition, there is an advance payment for the operating costs (“ancillary costs”) of 350 euros per month, which are billed. Electricity consumption is also included in the operating costs. 

The house can be rented for at least six months and for longer. 

Smoking is not permitted in the house.

TV: Sat connection is the standard. A cable connection is only available for the Smart TV in the living room and only as long as this is provided for in the contract with the respective internet provider.

The energy certificate is available for viewing.

Please contact me by message via HousingAnywhere.

title: Mühlenweg, Bremen
description:
Exclusive Fully Furnished 2-Room Apartment for Temporary Living
Prime Location in Bremen-Oberneuland

First Occupancy 2026 · Smart Home · High-End Features · Excellent Connectivity

Located in one of Bremen’s most desirable residential areas – the prestigious villa district of Oberneuland – this high-quality, fully renovated and fully furnished 2-room garden apartment offers approximately 60 m2 of living space on the ground floor.
The neighborhood is characterized by elegant single-family homes, mature trees, lakes, and park landscapes. You will enjoy peaceful, green, and private living, while benefiting from excellent connections to Bremen’s city center, technology park, and key business locations.

Premium Temporary Living
The apartment will be occupied for the first time in 2026 after a complete renovation. All furnishings and fittings are new and carefully selected with one goal in mind:
Move in, unpack your personal belongings – and feel at home immediately.

Highlights
* 2 rooms with open kitchen and comfortable bathroom
* Fully furnished with high-quality interior design
* Triple-glazed windows with electric exterior blinds
* Modern continuous laminate flooring with underfloor heating
* Open, fully equipped kitchen with induction cooktop, oven, dishwasher, kettle & toaster
* Towels, bed linen, household items and complete kitchen equipment included
* Washing machine with dryer function
* Iron, ironing board, cordless vacuum cleaner and hair dryer
* Height-adjustable workspace with monitor
* Smart home control center (tablet-based system)
* Smart TV & high-speed Wi-Fi
* Parking is readily available on the access street in front of the property.

The apartment is ideally suited for up to two persons.
(The double bed can be separated into two single beds 90 × 200 cm upon request.)

Ideal For
* Corporate employees & company apartments
* Project managers, consultants & executives
* Expats & international professionals
* Commuters with a second residence
* Temporary accommodation during construction, renovation or relocation phases

Transport Connections & Business Locations
The Bremen-Oberneuland train station is only approx. 500 meters away. From there you can reach Bremen city center / main station in about 8 minutes.
The BSAG bus lines 33 and 34 are within 5 minutes walking distance.

Excellent Location for Commuters

* Bremen city center: approx. 15 minutes
* Motorway A27 (Neue Vahr / Oberneuland exit): approx. 5 minutes
Bremer Kreuz interchange: approx. 6 km
(A1 Hamburg ↔ Osnabrück and A27 Bremerhaven/Cuxhaven ↔ Hannover)

Several well-known employers are located within close proximity:

10–15 minutes

15–20 minutes

20–30 minutes
* Airbus Bremen

* DMK Deutsches Milchkontor

Infrastructure & Quality of Life
Supermarkets, doctors, pharmacies, Klinikum Bremen-Ost hospital, as well as numerous recreational opportunities (lakes, cycling routes, sports clubs, golf club) are located nearby.
The combination of nature, tranquility, and proximity to the city makes this location particularly attractive for demanding tenants.

Shopping & Services

* Additional services nearby:

Sports & Clubs

Lakes & Parks

* Furnished temporary living (1–12 months, extension possible)
